tools.name: bill4time_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (id, name, billing name, email, phone, city, account manager, status, billing rate type, currency). Filter by status, exact client name, id or creation date. Street addresses and tax ids are not returned. GET /clients.

tools.name: bill4time_list_projects
tools.description: List projects (matters): id, name, client, status, billing method, rate overrides, assigned user, created/closed/due dates. Filter by status, billing method, client, id or creation date. GET /projects.

tools.name: bill4time_list_time_entries
tools.description: List time entries: client, project, user, entry date, billable and labor time, billable amount, rate, activity, ABA litigation code, billing status, invoice id, public description. Filter by client, project, user, invoice, entry date range or billing status. Private notes and contractor pay rates ar

tools.name: bill4time_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses: client, project, user, expense date, cost and sell price, quantity, type, billing status, invoice id, public description. Filter by client, project, user, invoice, expense date range, billing status or exact expense type. Private notes are not returned unless include_private_notes is

tools.name: bill4time_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices: client, project, invoice date, status (prebill or finalized), paid status, totals (invoice, labor, expense, late fee), terms and notes. Filter by status, paid status, client, project, id or invoice date range. GET /invoices.

tools.name: bill4time_list_payments
tools.description: List payments: client, project, amount, date, type, method, public note. Filter by client, project, id or payment date range. Check numbers are not returned; the private note only with include_private_notes. GET /payments.

tools.name: bill4time_list_users
tools.description: List the firm's users: name, email, user type, status, department, position, billing and overtime rate. Birth dates, addresses, phone numbers and contractor pay rates are not returned. Filter by status or id. GET /users.

tools.name: bill4time_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts: name, email, work and mobile phone, city, status, creation date. Filter by status, id or creation date. Street addresses, home phone and notes are not returned. GET /contacts.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bill4time_list_clients, bill4time_list_users, bill4time_list_contacts · Private data: bill4time_list_time_entries, bill4time_list_expenses, bill4time_list_payments, bill4time_list_contacts · Public sink: bill4time_list_clients, bill4time_list_users, bill4time_list_contacts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bill4time_list_clients, bill4time_list_users, bill4time_list_contacts · Private data: bill4time_list_time_entries, bill4time_list_expenses, bill4time_list_payments, bill4time_list_contacts · Public sink: bill4time_list_clients, bill4time_list_users, bill4time_list_contacts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
